items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Les Robinson's band, which was the band that I -- the last band that I played with, [1936] 1935.

ctx.x: Well, according to the Encyclopedia here, you played with local bands from 1933 until 1935. What kinds of bands were those?

We had the best bands in Philly. Jimmy Shine's Jungle Band, you know, had those odd names. Les Robinson's band, which was the band that I -- the last band that I played with, [1936] 1935. Bessie Smith, that was her last engagement before she went South and got in the automobile accident.

items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Les Robinson and Ted Tinsley (PHONETIC) was trumpets, Al Moore was the pianist then.

ctx.x: Must have been a few Les Robinsons, over the years.
Les Robinson and Ted Tinsley (PHONETIC) was trumpets, Al Moore was the pianist then. He's a bass player now; he's with the Do Re Mi Trio.
